title: Recovered work
originalRequest: Develop a scheduling application to manage weekly rehearsals, sectionals, venue bookings, and instrument allocation for a regional brass band.
latestMessage: Develop a scheduling application to manage weekly rehearsals, sectionals, venue bookings, and instrument allocation for a regional brass band.

steps.title: Define Database Schema
steps.instruction: Create the database migrations for band members, instrument inventory, venues, and rehearsal events, including tables for sections (e.g., Cornet, Horn, Trombone, Euphonium, Tuba, Percussion).
steps.acceptance: Database migrations run successfully on the local development environment and generate the correct tables and foreign keys.

steps.title: Build Section Lead Notification Trigger
steps.instruction: Set up a background worker or cron trigger that sends notifications to relevant section leaders when a sectional rehearsal is scheduled or modified.
steps.acceptance: System sends simulated notifications to configured section leaders' endpoints when a matching database record is created.

steps.title: Configure Venue Conflict Check Utility
steps.instruction: Write a utility class that queries existing rehearsal records for overlapping time slots and returns a list of conflicts when scheduling a new event.
steps.acceptance: Unit tests confirm that scheduling an event at the exact same venue and time slot throws a validation error, while adjacent slots succeed.
steps.result: Developed the VenueConflictChecker utility. Added unit test cases covering complete overlap, partial overlap, adjacent times, and different venues. All unit tests pass with zero regressions.

steps.title: Create Rehearsal Management API
steps.instruction: Implement REST endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting rehearsal events under /api/rehearsals.
steps.acceptance: All CRUD endpoints are functional, secure, validate payload structures, and return standard HTTP status codes.
steps.result: Completed construction of /api/rehearsals controller. Configured JSON schema validators for payload formats. Handled negative cases (e.g., invalid date formats, missing required fields) with 400 Bad Request responses.

steps.title: Implement Instrument Allocation Tracking
steps.instruction: Integrate instrument tracking into the scheduling database so that shared instruments (e.g., timpani, tubular bells) can be reserved for specific rehearsals.
steps.acceptance: The scheduling form rejects rehearsal creation if a requested instrument is already reserved by another rehearsal occurring at the same time.
steps.result: Successfully linked the instrument reservation system to the core scheduler. Added relational constraints preventing duplicate resource booking. Verification checks pass.

steps.title: Build Calendar UI Dashboard
steps.instruction: Construct a basic web frontend dashboard view displaying a calendar of upcoming rehearsal dates, categorized by full band vs. sectionals.
steps.acceptance: The frontend calendar UI loads without error, fetches scheduled rehearsals from the API, and color-codes sessions based on event type.
steps.result: Created a lightweight frontend interface using HTML and CSS. Successfully integrated it with the rehearsal schedule API. Checked layout responsiveness on standard screen sizes.
